newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PROMOTED BARI CONFIRM FASCETTI AS COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PROMOTED BARI CONFIRM FASCETTI AS COACH.

text.p: Newly-promoted Italian soccer club Bari on Tuesday confirmed Eugenio Fascetti as coach for their return to Serie A next season.
The confirmation knocked on the head media reports that the southern club was considering dumping Fascetti in favour of outgoing AC Milan coach Arrigo Sacchi.
Sacchi was closely allied to former Italian soccer federation head Antonio Matarrese, whose brother Vincenzo is the president of Bari.
Fascetti was appointed coach in December 1995, when Bari were still in Serie A, in place of Giuseppe Materazzi.
He kept his job after they were relegated at the end of that season and engineered Bari's immediate return.
